title: Sharp Detection of Total Variation Shifts between Categorical Potential Outcome Margins
banked_reason: Sound sharp first-order categorical detection theorem assessed subfield: paper_score_ceiling 6.8 < 7.4; no bounded faithful field repair.
gap_reasons: The principal practical shortfall is the attainment construction: its cutoff cannot reach two until both K and n/K are at least 2^64, and the conservative calibration supplies no demonstrated useful finite power near the sharp constant.

The finite enumerations check identities rather than establish operating characteristics, and total rational computability supplies neither an efficient implementation nor evidence supporting the prospective retail use.
the delivered package does not establish a broadly adopted framework or resolve a recognized major open problem.

proof_attempt_summary: Independently derived the sharp fixed-gap 1/sqrt(pi) categorical empirical-TV detection frontier, with a finite weak-null-valid observable attainer and complete-record all-test converse. D0 mathematical review passed and all three inherited sources were attested; D0.5 graded the delivered package subfield at 6.8 against the field threshold 7.4 because finite-power, implementation and practical-impact claims were not delivered. No Lean formalization was started; boundary and critical-window theory remain outside scope, and identical same-scope retries are ruled out.
tldr: The total variation between two fixed empirical categorical potential margins has sharp first-order maximin detection constant \(1/\sqrt\pi\) under balanced complete randomization when \(K\to\infty\) and \(K/n\to0\). Below this constant times \(\sqrt{K/n}\), all weak-null-valid original-record tests have worst-case power tending to \(1/20\). Above it, one total deterministic observable test has uniform power tending to one and finite weak-null size at most \(1/20\) for every legal experiment. The proof derives uniform scalar transfer, empty-cell perspective stability, assignment concentration, and exact ordered-record urn equality. A certified rational interval algorithm implements the attainer. The prospective consumer is a prespecified fixed-user first-purchase SKU trial with a public no-purchase category.
gap: Cohen--Fogarty provides exact sharp-null and asymptotic weak-null calibration under fixed-dimensional regularity; Kim--Balakrishnan--Wasserman studies independent-sample distribution testing. Their published guarantees do not determine a sharp dense-alphabet empirical-TV frontier under arbitrary fixed potential pairing.
fill: A uniform finite error certificate and full-record equal-law converse target the exact first-order roster requirement \(n\delta^2/K=1/\pi\), away from equality. The final observable construction and both matching branches remain proof obligations.
